name: mxverify BV API
description:
The BV API returns the same figure a site's mxverify report and badge show. A free key from https://bklink.uk/api-keys gives 1,000 lookups and 25 new valuations a day; the partner tier adds volume and bulk valuation jobs, paid per call from a bklink wallet.

Wherever you show a BV, show "BV by mxverify" beside it, linked to the site's report (`attribution` in every valued or unrated result). BV is the ranking benefit of a link under a published model, not a price.

Full documentation: https://bklink.uk/docs/api
